scope.source: real private Rust LSDP daemon + Solar host dist + pinned Vision dist
scope.browser: private headless Chrome; no CEF, no physical camera, no audio, no scene switch
scope.presentationBoundary: Vision frame-submitted followed by Solar CanvasPresentation retained-front-canvas copy; no GPU-completion or physical-scanout claim

producer.pacing: deadline with setImmediate near deadline; dedicated producer CPU

pixels.source: Solar CanvasPresentation retained front canvas (2D copy after Vision frame-submitted)

limitations.gpuCompletion: unavailable; Vision exposes frame-submitted and submission-call measurements only
limitations.physicalScanout: not measured; evidence is the private browser retained front canvas
limitations.transactionAckHash: unavailable on the native apply ACK; observed Solar receive/applied hashes and final authoritative state are compared separately
limitations.browserCoverage: received/applied event coverage includes only mutations observed before any explicit resync; resync snapshot recovery is reported separately
